headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 26, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Kansas City Royals 13-2, with Junior Caminero leading the Royals' offense with 3 hits, 3 home runs, and 6 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 5-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Bubba Chandler earning the win. The Oakland Athletics secured a 9-6 victory over the San Francisco Giants, with Geoff Hartlieb earning the win and Mason Barnett securing the save.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. The San Francisco Giants placed catcher Daniel Susac on the 10-day injured list due to a low back strain. The Chicago Cubs placed right-hander Phil Maton on the 15-day injured list with right knee tendinitis. The Boston Red Sox placed second baseman Marcelo Mayer on the 10-day injured list with a bone stress reaction to the left ulna. The Atlanta Braves placed right-hander Robert Suarez on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 23, 2026, with right forearm tightness.

The Chicago Cubs acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson in a trade with the New York Mets. The St. Louis Cardinals traded right-hander Chris Roycroft to the Tampa Bay Rays for a player to be named later. The Houston Astros acquired shortstop Marcus Brown from the Washington Nationals for cash. The Washington Nationals traded right-hander Tyler Schoff to the Atlanta Braves. The Houston Astros traded right-hander Jayden Murray to the Chicago Cubs for first baseman Cameron Sisneros.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Rays in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Kansas City Royals 13-2, handing them a lopsided loss. Junior Caminero led the Royals' offense with 3 hits, 3 home runs, and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Mariners 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 5-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Bubba Chandler earning the win. Brandon Lowe led the Mariners' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Giants 9-6**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 9-6 victory over the San Francisco Giants, with Geoff Hartlieb earning the win and Mason Barnett securing the save.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Tigers in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros edged out the Detroit Tigers 2-1, with Tatsuya Imai pitching 6.0 innings of scoreless ball, striking out 10 batters. Taylor Trammell led the Astros' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Giants Place C Daniel Susac on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants catcher Daniel Susac has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a low back strain.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson in a trade. Peterson joins the Cubs after being previously traded from the New York Mets.
